layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records and export panel

graderOnly: No material defects exist: the implementation matches the technical design and the full test suite (31 tests) passes.

The TypeScript documentation surface is RecordExporter.exportRecords(user, query), reached as createApp().exporter.exportRecords: an async method whose failures are promise rejections, never synchronous throws (HttpError 401 authentication required, 403 forbidden, 400 unknown status, all before any folder or file is written; file-system errors reject with the unchanged Node error). It resolves to fileName, path, count, and csv.

The HTML documentation surface is the fragment from renderExportPanel({ action, filter, count }) in src/views/exportPanel.ts: a section labelled by its h2 through aria-labelledby, a summary paragraph referenced by the button through aria-describedby, one escaped hidden input per set filter, and a submit button that is disabled when count is 0. Its element ids are fixed, so a page holds at most one panel, and the fragment performs no authorization.

The CSS documentation surface is src/views/export-panel.css with nine --export-panel-* custom properties whose defaults are declared on .export-panel itself, so values set on :root or another ancestor do not reach the panel; overrides go on .export-panel in a later stylesheet. The design also states contrast (on-accent over accent, text over surface at least 4.5:1) and layout constraints (single-column grid, max width, right-aligned button, 2.5rem minimum height, accent focus outline).
There is no Python code or Python documentation surface anywhere in the repository; loading the Documenter python.md style is unrelated work.
docs/usage.md has no export section, and README.md's Layout section does not list src/export/ or src/views/.

notes: Built on export-project (the pre-install records service) rather than export-documenting, because export-documenting's synchronous route and its scope non-goal excluding front-end work cannot hold a TypeScript async public method, an HTML component, and CSS custom properties without invalidating its verification and review evidence. Eight post-install commits write the same cycle id in brownfield order. 50-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md (no views, no stylesheets, front end outside the repo, short // comments and no doc generator) and STATE SCOPING. 52-scope: AC-001 (admin-only filtered CSV export started from an embeddable export panel, RFC 4180 quoting, server-side denial before any file) and AC-002 (docs/usage.md describes who may export, filters, how the admin tool starts an export and what it returns, writes, and fails with, and how to embed and style the panel); STATE ARCHITECTING. 54-design: async RecordExporter.exportRecords contract with rejection semantics, CSV format, file location, renderExportPanel fragment structure and accessibility attributes, stylesheet custom properties with defaults, cascade, contrast, and layout constraints; AC-002 No architectural impact; STATE DEVELOPING. 56-plan: APPROVED plan, three PENDING steps for AC-001, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE. 58-export: src/export/csv.ts, src/export/exporter.ts, src/views/exportPanel.ts, src/views/export-panel.css, createApp exposes exporter, .gitignore exports/, three new test files (15 tests, 31 total). 60-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-check evidence, STATE TESTING. 62-verification: COMPLETE FULL verification, AC-002 pending Documenter; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 64-review: COMPLETE IMPLEMENTATION review with no material findings, AC-002 permitted dependency; STATE DOCUMENTING. docs/usage.md and README.md are unchanged from export-project.
